question: The outer circumference of the top of a large hemispherical iron bowl is 565.2 cm and the bowl is 6 cm thick. What will be the volume (in cm³) of the iron required to make this bowl? (Use π = 3.14.)

The outer circumference of the top of a large hemispherical iron bowl is 565.2 cm and the bowl is 6 cm thick.
